agreed: 2026-11-18 (SIX SERVICES UPDATE, master blueprint 69.7; the document engine built in section 4 step E3)
rule: LynkFiles is the document engine every service stores and signs through, read only through core/files.py and ts/src/files.ts (python3 tools/files_vectors.py after a change). A file lives under the record it belongs to and follows that service's access rules; its content is checked by its bytes, never its name; every version is kept and fingerprinted; storage follows the plan; nothing under legal hold is deleted. A signature request goes to signers in order or together, on any phone without an account; identity-checked and qualified signatures go only through their licensed partners and are never shown as signed before the partner confirms. A signed document gets a code anyone can check, which shows only its fingerprint and whether it is complete, never who signed. A share link has its rights, an end date and, if set, a password; it can be stopped at once. Every open, change, share and signature is in the audit log.

content.rule: The type is read from the first bytes. Programs (Windows, Linux and Mac programs, Java classes and scripts) are refused; text must be valid UTF-8 with no control characters other than tab and new line. Office files are zip files and are scanned by the scanning partner when it is signed; until then they are kept but not opened in a browser.

simple.note: A signer opens their own link, sees the whole document and signs; the link, the time and the device are recorded.

identity_checked.note: The licensed identity partner checks the signer first.

qualified.note: Through a recognised trust-service partner where a country requires a qualified signature.

sharing.rule: A link always has an end date; downloading can be blocked and a watermark added; a person's own vault documents are shared for at most default_days unless they choose longer.
